newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Lihir says pours first gold at PNG mine.
newsitem.headline: Lihir says pours first gold at PNG mine.

text.p: Lihir Gold Ltd said on Monday that it had commenced production of gold dore following the commissioning of the ore processing and production facilities at its gold mine on the Papua New Guinea (PNG) island of Lihir.

In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), Lihir Gold said anticipated ore output from the mine in May was about 150,000 tonnes. "Commissioning of the sulphide processing facilities remain on schedule for August 1997," Lihir Gold said.
The company announced on May 1 that it had started processing oxide ore at its newly constructed plant.
Lihir Gold forecasts gold production of 175,000 ounces in calendar 1997, and over 600,000 a year when in full production.
The company is 22.9 percent owned by Southern Gold, which is itself owned 75 percent by RTZ-CRA and 25 percent by Vengold Inc.
Niugini Mining Ltd owns 17.15 percent and Orogen Minerals Ltd eight percent.
